claims.text: In his 8 August 1990 address the U.S. President says that, after consulting with King Fahd, he sent the Secretary of Defense to discuss cooperative measures; the Public Papers editorial note identifies him as King Fahd bin Abd al-Aziz Al Saud of Saudi Arabia.
claims.locator: Address body, consultation paragraph; closing editorial Note
claims.uncertainty: A foreign official record, not a Saudi royal record, read from a presidential-library web transcription of the Public Papers rather than the GPO print edition. It attests the title on this date only; it gives no accession date, term start or continuity.

scope_note: Used only as the 1990 opening-window observation of King Fahd (SA-EXEC-01). No Saudi record from 1990 was retrieved.

Its address span is byte-identical to the originally recorded response's. Because it is a different URL, it corroborates the recorded text with a pre-cutoff, reproducible identity; it does not replace the originally recorded response.
